C0258.title: Illegal Traffic Diversion in Underground Industry: From Streamer Bait to Prostitution Ads
C0258.summary: A 2024 Tencent News report details a Shanghai police case where suspects posted fake part-time job ads on recruitment sites under the guise of 'boosting streamer popularity' or 'increasing e-commerce store sales,' diverting applicants to task-scam platforms or other illegal schemes.
